title: Trie Dictionary
statement:
Implement a trie representing a multiset of lowercase words, initially empty.

Input
q, then q lines OP word. ADD inserts a copy. ERASE removes one copy if present and otherwise does nothing. COUNT asks for exact multiplicity. PREFIX asks for the total multiplicity of words starting with word.

Output
Print the answer to each COUNT or PREFIX.

Constraints
1 ≤ q ≤ 200000. Words are nonempty. The total length of all words in the input is at most 400000.

samples.input:
8
ADD app
ADD apple
ADD app
PREFIX app
ERASE app
COUNT app
ERASE absent
PREFIX appl
